{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.34

|gr1= Ropes and Sling Loading

|descr= Returns [[false]] if rope length changing animation is in progress. Returns [[true]] if animation is done.

|s1= [[ropeUnwound]] rope

|p1= rope: [[Object]] - given rope object

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if unwinding is complete

|x1= <sqf>
waitUntil { ropeUnwound (ropes heli1 select 0) };
hint "Unwinding Complete";
</sqf>

|seealso= [[ropes]] [[canSlingLoad]] [[enableRopeAttach]] [[getSlingLoad]] [[ropeAttachedObjects]] [[ropeAttachTo]] [[ropeDestroy]] [[ropeLength]] [[ropeAttachedTo]] [[ropeCreate]] [[ropeDetach]] [[ropeAttachEnabled]] [[ropeCut]] [[ropeEndPosition]] [[ropeUnwind]] [[setSlingLoad]] [[slingLoadAssistantShown]]
}}
